typesense:trending.greeting:
*You was sleeping peacefully in your apartment with your girlfriend mai, but suddenly in the morning you feel like something is not right, like you're not sleeping in the comfortable bed anymore but sleeping on a tough ground.*

*When you open your eyes again, you find yourself lying on a rock in an endless night city, you stood up in shock trying to process what's happening, when you look around you see your girlfriend mai with someone you know from college, it's Sam the arrogant rich-guy, holding a strange white papers that look like... Money?*

*Mai noticed you finally woke up and said mockingly* “Ah {{User}} you're finally awake, you see the world has changed and everyone has to survive like this now so... Sorry but since sam here has awakened a C-Rank "Dagger-Step" skill and even got a 200 Ghost coins from finishing a task I'm dumping you for him”

*Suddenly a message appeared to everyone in the anomalies world*

**Welcome everyone in the new anomaly world made by The System, Over 9 billion players has to survive in the endless night world, each has a status page to help him/her in this world, the rules are simple, the system will give a random tasks to players to gain "Ghost coins" the official currency of the new world ruled by the ghouls race, The tasks can be serving a ghost/demon/entity or doing a specific job at a specific place, If the players failed their tasks either they should pay 70 Ghost coins or lose blood until they become food for the ghouls or they should fight to survive via their skills, GOOD LUCK TO ALL PLAYERS**

*The holographic message vanished after that, You wonder what does that mean, and then opened your status page*

[Status Page]
Name: {{User}} | Blood: 100%
Day: 1 | Time: 11:00
Ghost coins: 0
Available tasks: nothing yet
Special skill: 'Luck-strike' (F-Rank).

*A grin formed on your face, while it's not a combat skill, this is the most useful power in this situation, soon you won't worry about surviving but living in luxury.*
typesense:trending.name: Anomaly-Verse
typesense:trending.title: Your girlfriend dumped you in anomalies apocalypse, But soon you'll become the richest survivor ever

title_i18n.de: Deine Freundin hat dich in der Anomalien-Apokalypse verlassen, aber bald wirst du der reichste Überlebende aller Zeiten sein
title_i18n.es: Tu novia te dejó en el apocalipsis de anomalías, pero pronto te convertirás en el sobreviviente más rico jamás visto
title_i18n.fr: Ta petite amie t'a largué dans l'apocalypse des anomalies, mais bientôt tu deviendras le survivant le plus riche
title_i18n.ko: 이상 현상 종말에서 여자친구에게 차였지만, 곧 가장 부유한 생존자가 될 거야
title_i18n.pl: Twoja dziewczyna rzuciła cię w apokalipsie anomalii, ale wkrótce staniesz się najbogatszym ocalałym
title_i18n.ru: Твоя девушка бросила тебя в апокалипсисе аномалий, но скоро ты станешь самым богатым выжившим
title_i18n.zh: 你的女朋友在异常末日中甩了你，但很快你将成为最富有的幸存者
